name: IMG_4809 10 fps proxy (validated reference)
note: The recording every 5.x accuracy and CPU speed result was measured on. Built by concatenating the 12 proxy pieces (stream copy, +faststart) on 2026-10-28; on the owner's computer as Downloads/Mobile Devices/IMG_4809_proxy_10fps.mp4. The original IMG_4809.MOV is HEVC 1080p at 30 fps (2034.9 s) - 3x the stage-1 frames, accuracy not validated. Identity is the video-stream hash (ffmpeg streamhash sha256): the copy remuxed in the development container with ffmpeg 6.1.1 has file SHA-256 007cd4e5...f9aa but the same stream hash.
